description: Migrate AuthProvider from Firebase Auth to Supabase Auth. Replace all Firebase authentication (email/password sign-up/sign-in, Google OAuth, onAuthStateChanged, token refresh) with Supabase equivalents (supabase.auth.signUp, supabase.auth.signInWithPassword, supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth for Google, supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange). Update Auth.tsx page, AccountSwitcherSheet.tsx, multiAccount.ts, and any other files using Firebase Auth directly.
steps: Rewrite src/contexts/AuthProvider.tsx: Replace Firebase onAuthStateChanged with supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange. Replace firebaseSignOut with supabase.auth.signOut. Replace createUserWithEmailAndPassword with supabase.auth.signUp. Replace signInWithEmailAndPassword with supabase.auth.signInWithPassword. Remove Firebase token refresh logic. Map Supabase user to the existing User/Profile types. Keep createProfileInSupabase and profile hydration logic intact.

Rewrite src/pages/Auth.tsx: Replace signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, ...) with supabase.auth.signInWithPassword. Replace createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, ...) with supabase.auth.signUp. Replace signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider) with supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google' }). Replace profile reads from Firestore doc(db, 'profiles', uid) with supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('user_id', uid). Replace profile writes (setDoc to Firestore 'profiles') with supabase.from('profiles').upsert(...). Remove the Firestore 'usernames' collection writes (consolidate into profiles table).

Update src/components/layout/AccountSwitcherSheet.tsx: Replace signInWithEmailAndPassword from firebase/auth with supabase.auth.signInWithPassword. Remove import of auth and db from @/lib/firebase. Remove Firestore getDoc for profiles, use supabase.from('profiles').
Update src/lib/multiAccount.ts: Remove Firebase auth imports. Update switchToAccount to use supabase.auth.setSession or note it requires re-login via Supabase.

Update src/lib/signupChecks.ts: Replace Firestore reads/writes (doc(db, 'usernames', ...), doc(db, 'email_accounts', ...)) with supabase.from('usernames') and supabase.from('email_accounts') or supabase RPC calls.
Run TypeScript check and build to confirm compilation
acceptance_criteria: AuthProvider uses supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange instead of Firebase onAuthStateChanged
Google auth uses supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth with provider: 'google'
No imports from 'firebase/auth' remain in these files
No imports from '@/lib/firebase' for auth remain in these files
verification: Run 'bunx tsc --noEmit' and confirm no new type errors
Run 'bun run build' and confirm build succeeds
Run 'bun run test -- --run' and confirm tests pass
